image_description: A vintage, heavy-duty charcoal or coal-fired iron resting on a dark wooden stand against a teal backdrop. The iron features a cast metal body with significant signs of age and use (rust, pitting), a curved wooden handle attached via metal brackets, and a row of circular ventilation holes along the side of the base. It lacks a modern power cord.
